dog.seoContent.faq1Answer.en: Our dog age calculator uses the AAHA 2023 life stage guidelines, which account for breed size differences. Small dogs age slower than large dogs — a 5-year-old Chihuahua is roughly 36 human years, while a 5-year-old Great Dane is about 48.
dog.seoContent.faq1Answer.hi: हमारा कुत्ते की आयु कैलकुलेटर AAHA 2023 जीवन चरण दिशानिर्देशों का उपयोग करता है।

dog.seoContent.faq2.en: How do I calculate my dog's daily calorie needs?

dog.seoContent.faq2Answer.en: Our calorie calculator uses the AAFCO Maintenance Energy Requirement (MER) formula: RER × activity multiplier. RER = 70 × (weight in kg)^0.75. The multiplier adjusts for neuter status, activity level, and life stage.
dog.seoContent.faq2Answer.hi: हमारा कैलोरी कैलकुलेटर AAFCO Maintenance Energy Requirement (MER) सूत्र का उपयोग करता है।

dog.seoContent.faq3.hi: मेरे कुत्ते को कौन से टीके चाहिए?

dog.seoContent.faq3Answer.en: Core vaccines (required for all dogs) include rabies, DHPP (distemper, hepatitis, parvovirus, parainfluenza). Non-core vaccines like Bordetella and Leptospirosis depend on your region and lifestyle. Our schedule follows WSAVA 2024 guidelines.
dog.seoContent.faq3Answer.hi: मुख्य टीकों में रैबीज़, DHPP शामिल है। हमारी अनुसूची WSAVA 2024 दिशानिर्देशों का पालन करती है।

cat.seoContent.faq1.en: How old is my cat in human years?
cat.seoContent.faq1.hi: मेरी बिल्ली की उम्र मानव वर्षों में कितनी है?

cat.seoContent.faq1Answer.en: Cats age differently from dogs and humans. A 1-year-old cat is roughly 15 human years. A 5-year-old cat is about 36. Our calculator uses the AAHA/AAFP feline life stage guidelines.
cat.seoContent.faq1Answer.hi: 1 साल की बिल्ली लगभग 15 मानव वर्षों के बराबर है।

cat.seoContent.faq2.en: Is my cat overweight? How to use the BCS scale?
cat.seoContent.faq2.hi: क्या मेरी बिल्ली अधिक वजन वाली है? BCS स्केल का उपयोग कैसे करें?

cat.seoContent.faq2Answer.en: The Body Condition Score (BCS) is a 1–9 scale developed by veterinarians. You can assess your cat at home by feeling their ribs and looking at their waist from above. 60% of indoor cats score above 5 (ideal). Our BCS tool guides you through the assessment and calculates a safe weight target.
cat.seoContent.faq2Answer.hi: शारीरिक स्थिति स्कोर (BCS) एक 1-9 स्केल है।

cat.seoContent.faq3.en: How much water should my cat drink daily?
cat.seoContent.faq3.hi: मेरी बिल्ली को रोजाना कितना पानी पीना चाहिए?

cat.seoContent.faq3Answer.en: Cats need approximately 50–60 ml of water per kg of body weight daily. Cats on dry food diets need more supplemental water. Our hydration calculator accounts for both dry and wet food intake.
cat.seoContent.faq3Answer.hi: बिल्लियों को लगभग 50-60 ml पानी प्रति किलो वजन प्रतिदिन चाहिए।

cat.seoContent.faq4.en: What vaccines does my indoor cat need?
cat.seoContent.faq4.hi: मेरी घरेलू बिल्ली को कौन से टीके चाहिए?

cat.seoContent.faq4Answer.en: Core vaccines for all cats include FVRCP (feline viral rhinotracheitis, calicivirus, panleukopenia) and rabies. Even indoor cats need these — the FVRCP series starts at 6–8 weeks with boosters every 3 years.
cat.seoContent.faq4Answer.hi: सभी बिल्लियों के लिए मुख्य टीकों में FVRCP और रैबीज़ शामिल हैं।

cat.seoContent.faq5Answer.en: Cats are pregnant for approximately 65 days (range 61–72 days). Our gestation calculator provides the expected due date range and key veterinary milestones during pregnancy.
cat.seoContent.faq5Answer.hi: बिल्लियां लगभग 65 दिन (सीमा 61-72 दिन) गर्भवती रहती हैं।

dogAge.scienceSection.title.en: Why we don't use the "7× rule"
dogAge.scienceSection.title.hi: हम '7× नियम' का उपयोग क्यों नहीं करते

dogAge.scienceSection.body.en: The popular "multiply by 7" formula has no scientific basis. Dogs mature rapidly in the first 2 years (reaching sexual maturity and full size), then age more slowly thereafter. Our calculator uses size-adjusted life stage guidelines from: the American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA) and the 2020 UCSD epigenetics methylation study (Labrador reference). Larger breeds age faster due to higher metabolic rates and faster cell division — not because of size itself.
dogAge.scienceSection.body.hi: लोकप्रिय '7 से गुणा करें' सूत्र का कोई वैज्ञानिक आधार नहीं है।

en.title: Cost-Effective
en.body: Kibble costs $0.30–$0.80 per day for a 30kg dog, vs $1.50–$4.00 for wet food. Savings come from lower water content (10% vs 75%) and more efficient manufacturing.

en.title: Dental Benefits
en.body: The mechanical crunching action of hard kibble can help reduce tartar buildup. However, most dogs do not chew long enough for significant dental benefit — it is a bonus, not a substitute for brushing.

en.title: Shelf-Stable & Convenient
en.body: Unopened bags last 12–18 months at room temperature. No refrigeration needed, easy to store and travel with. Portioning is straightforward with a measuring cup.

en.title: Energy-Dense
en.body: With 350–450 kcal per 100g, kibble is ideal for large breeds or active dogs who need many calories without feeling full too quickly.

en.title: High Moisture Content

en.question: Can I mix dry and wet dog food?
en.answer: Yes, mixing is safe and often recommended. A common approach is 75% kibble + 25% wet food by calorie. Calculate your dog's total daily calorie needs first, then split between the two. Ensure the combined diet meets AAFCO nutrient profiles — most complete & balanced kibble is formulated to be fed alone, so treat wet food as a supplement.

en.question: Is wet food better for dogs with kidney disease?
en.answer: Often yes. The high moisture content (75–80%) helps support kidney function by promoting hydration and flushing toxins. Dogs with chronic kidney disease (CKD) are frequently recommended higher-moisture diets by veterinary nutritionists. A prescription renal diet (wet or dry) may be needed in advanced cases.

en.question: How much wet food replaces one cup of kibble?
en.answer: Approximately 1 cup of kibble (100g, ~350 kcal) equals about 300–400g of wet food (~350 kcal). Always check the calorie content on the can label and adjust based on your dog's specific caloric needs. Use our Dog Calorie Calculator to determine the exact amount.

en.question: Do dogs need wet food?
en.answer: No, dogs do not need wet food if they are eating a complete and balanced dry diet and drinking adequate water. However, wet food provides meaningful benefits for hydration, palatability, and specific health conditions. It is a valuable tool in the dog owner's toolkit, not a necessity.

hi.question: Can I mix dry and wet dog food?
hi.answer: Yes, mixing is safe and often recommended. A common approach is 75% kibble + 25% wet food by calorie. Calculate your dog's total daily calorie needs first, then split between the two. Ensure the combined diet meets AAFCO nutrient profiles — most complete & balanced kibble is formulated to be fed alone, so treat wet food as a supplement.

en.title: Longer Lifespan
en.body: The average indoor-only cat lives 12–18 years, with many reaching 20+. This is 3–5x longer than the average outdoor cat, primarily due to reduced trauma and disease exposure.

en.title: Lower Disease Risk
en.body: Indoor cats have minimal exposure to FeLV, FIV, FIP, and rabies from other cats. Parasite exposure is also significantly reduced.

en.title: No Trauma Risk
en.body: No cars, no dog attacks, no fights with other cats, no predator encounters. The #1 cause of premature death in outdoor cats is vehicular trauma.

en.title: Better Weight Control
en.body: Indoor cats are fed measured meals rather than hunting or scavenging. Combined with our BCS tracker, obesity is more easily managed.

en.question: Is it cruel to keep a cat indoors?
en.answer: No — with proper environmental enrichment, indoor cats live longer, healthier lives. Cats do not have the same drive for outdoor access as dogs. Key needs: vertical space (cat trees), scratching posts, puzzle feeders, window perches with a view, and 15–20 minutes of daily interactive play. This satisfies their core behavioral needs entirely.

en.question: How do I transition an outdoor cat to indoor?
en.answer: Gradual transition over 2–4 weeks is most effective. Start by bringing them in during meal times, then gradually increase indoor hours simultaneously adding enrichment (cat trees, toys, window perches). Use Feliway diffusers to reduce stress. Interactive wand toy sessions (2x 15min/day) are crucial for exercise and mental stimulation.

en.question: Do indoor cats need vaccines?
en.answer: Yes. Indoor cats still need core vaccines (FVRCP and rabies). While their disease risk is lower, these diseases can be transmitted via contaminated clothing, shoes, or through screens/windows. The AAFP classifies all cats as needing core vaccination regardless of lifestyle. Rabies vaccination is also legally required in most jurisdictions.

en.question: What is a catio and does it help?
en.answer: A catio is an enclosed outdoor structure (attached to a window, deck, or freestanding) that allows cats to experience the outdoors safely. Catios provide fresh air, sunshine, bird-watching, and sensory enrichment without the risks of free roaming. They are the single best compromise for owners who want outdoor access for their cat.

en.title: Whole, Unprocessed Ingredients
en.body: BARF diets use raw muscle meat, organs, bones, and vegetables — avoiding the high-heat processing that can destroy some nutrients. Proponents report shinier coats, cleaner teeth, and higher energy levels.

en.title: Dental Benefits
en.body: Chewing on raw meaty bones provides significant mechanical cleaning of teeth. Studies show reduced tartar in dogs on raw diets compared to kibble-fed dogs.

en.title: Bioavailable Nutrients
en.body: Raw proteins and fats are theoretically more bioavailable, with no heat-induced denaturation of amino acids. Some vitamins (B-complex, C) are better preserved without cooking.

en.title: No Artificial Additives
en.body: Quality raw diets avoid preservatives, colors, fillers, and artificial flavors often found in commercial pet food.

en.question: What is the 80-10-10 raw diet?
en.answer: The 80-10-10 ratio refers to 80% muscle meat, 10% raw meaty bone, and 10% organ meat (half liver, half other organs like kidney or spleen). This is a popular BARF formulation, though it may need calcium and micronutrient supplementation to meet NRC standards. The specific ratio should be tailored to your dog's life stage (puppies need more bone calcium).

en.question: Can puppies eat raw food?
en.answer: Yes, but with extreme caution. Puppies have higher calcium/phosphorus requirements for proper bone development. An improperly balanced raw diet can cause developmental orthopedic disease. If feeding raw to puppies, work with a veterinary nutritionist to ensure proper Ca:P ratio (1.2:1 to 1.4:1) and adequate trace minerals.

en.question: Is raw food better than kibble?
en.answer: "Better" depends on your priorities. Raw offers whole-food nutrition and dental benefits but carries bacterial risks and practical burdens. Kibble offers nutritional consistency and safety backed by decades of research. Neither is universally "better." The best diet is one that is nutritionally complete, safe for your family, sustainable for your budget, and that your dog thrives on.

en.title: Eliminates Pyometra Risk
en.body: Pyometra is a life-threatening uterine infection affecting 25% of unspayed females by age 10. Spaying eliminates this risk entirely — emergency pyometra surgery costs $3,000–$8,000 and carries 4–20% mortality even with treatment.

en.title: Dramatically Reduces Mammary Cancer
en.body: Spaying before the first heat cycle reduces mammary tumor risk by 99.5%; before the second heat by 92%. Mammary tumors are the most common cancer in unspayed females; ~50% are malignant.

en.title: Removes Reproductive Organ Cancer Risk
en.body: Spaying eliminates ovarian and uterine cancer (rare but documented). Neutering eliminates testicular cancer (the most common tumor in intact males).

en.title: Behavioral Benefits
en.body: Reduces roaming (males seeking females in heat), reduces inter-male aggression by up to 60%, and eliminates heat-related behaviors (bleeding, male attention, mood changes in females).

en.title: Population Control
en.body: Prevents accidental breeding and the resulting puppies. A single unspayed female and her offspring can theoretically produce 67,000 dogs in 6 years.

en.question: What is the best age to spay a large breed dog?
en.answer: For large breeds (Golden Retriever, Labrador, German Shepherd), current evidence suggests 12–18 months to allow proper closure of growth plates and reduce orthopedic disease risk. Giant breeds (Great Dane, Mastiff) may benefit from 18–24 months. Always discuss with your veterinarian, as cancer risk and joint risk vary by breed and sex.

en.question: Will my dog gain weight after being spayed?
en.answer: Likely yes. Spayed/neutered dogs require 20–30% fewer calories to maintain weight. Reduce food portions by 15–20% post-surgery and monitor body condition monthly using the BCS scale. Adjust as needed. Regular exercise is also crucial.

en.question: Can a spayed dog still get pregnant?
en.answer: No. A complete ovariohysterectomy (removal of uterus and ovaries) permanently eliminates the ability to conceive. A partial spay (ovaries only) is rarely performed and would still allow pregnancy in extremely rare cases where uterine tissue remains. Always confirm with your vet what procedure was performed.

en.title: Predictable Life Stages
en.body: Dogs have well-defined life stages by breed size: puppy, junior, adult, mature, senior, geriatric. AAHA guidelines provide clear health recommendations for each stage, making preventive care more systematic.

en.title: Size-Based Aging Models
en.body: Dog aging is strongly correlated with breed size. Small dogs (<10kg) live 12-16 years; giant breeds (>45kg) live 7-10 years. This predictability helps owners plan for long-term care needs.

en.title: Extensive Research
en.body: Decades of canine aging research (including the UCSD epigenetic clock study) provide data-driven insights into breed-specific health risks and longevity optimization.

hi.title: पूर्वानुमेय जीवन चरण
hi.body: कुत्तों के नस्ल के आकार के अनुसार अच्छी तरह परिभाषित जीवन चरण होते हैं: पिल्ला, किशोर, वयस्क, परिपक्व, वरिष्ठ, बुजुर्ग। AAHA दिशानिर्देश प्रत्येक चरण के लिए स्पष्ट स्वास्थ्य सिफारिशें प्रदान करते हैं, जिससे निवारक देखभाल अधिक व्यवस्थित हो जाती है।
